info.name: ERG Spring API - Full Smoke + Seed + GraphQL
info.description:
Full Postman collection for ERG Spring local smoke testing.

Cách dùng nhanh:
1. Chạy BE local với trusted header auth: ERG_SECURITY_TRUSTED_HEADER_AUTH_ENABLED=true.
2. Đảm bảo DB đã chạy migration V4/V7/V10. V4/V7 có seed LMS/LCMS/Auth; folder Seed trong collection sẽ tạo seed notification qua API thật.
3. Import collection này vào Postman, chạy folder "00 - Seed Data - Run First" trước.
4. Sau đó bấm Send từng REST/GraphQL request. Collection tự gắn X-User-ID, X-Tenant-ID, X-Permissions, X-Portals, X-Request-ID nếu request chưa override.

Lưu ý: Collection dùng local/test trusted headers để smoke nhanh. Production nên dùng Authorization Bearer từ /api/v1/auth/login.

item.name: 00 - Seed Data - Run First
item.description: Run this folder first. It creates realistic Firebase notification seed data through the real REST APIs, then reads teacher/student inboxes. Requires ERG_SECURITY_TRUSTED_HEADER_AUTH_ENABLED=true for local header auth.
